description: File a request to raise how many phone numbers this account may hold at once, for HonkIO staff to review. Live keys only: a test key gets 403 LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED. Only one request may be pending at a time (a second returns 409 ALLOWANCE_REQUEST_PENDING); the owner is emailed when it is decided.

reason.description: What the numbers are for. Staff decide on this.

requested_limit.description: Total numbers you want to be able to hold, not an increment. Must exceed the current limit (see get_account → phone_number_limit).

name: request_number_allowance
title: Request phone number allowance
